Shiiroi/mapa.title: Lens Production Milestone
Shiiroi/mapa.description: Deployed Lens v1.0.0 with full interactive choropleth rendering for all 17 Philippine administrative regions, 82 provinces, and 1,485 municipalities. Integrated 2020 PSA census demographics, COA annual municipal financial audits, 2022 presidential election tallies, and high-fidelity RFC 7946 GeoJSON vector downloads keyed by PSGC code.

Shiiroi/mapaph.title: Built-in Utilities, 82 Statutory Provinces, and SEO Architecture
Shiiroi/mapaph.description: Launched mapaPH Hub v2.0 with dedicated built-in utilities: interactive 1,742 PSGC Lookup and 9-digit code decoder with 1-click copy chips, bidirectional PRS92 to WGS84 GPS coordinate converter, strict 82 statutory provinces validation, executive geographic summary sheet, and comprehensive XML sitemap indexing.
